questions.question: What is Estathub?
questions.answer: Estathub is a Saudi proptech platform that enables fractional investment in real estate through blockchain tokens.

questions.question: How do I get started?
questions.answer: Simply create an account, complete verification, browse available properties, and start investing with as little as one token.

questions.question: What are property tokens?
questions.answer: Property tokens are digital representations of property ownership on the blockchain, enabling fractional ownership.

questions.question: Is my investment safe?
questions.answer: Yes, all investments are secured by legal property titles and protected by blockchain technology.

questions.question: How do I receive returns?
questions.answer: Returns are distributed monthly to your wallet based on your token ownership percentage.

questions.question: Can I sell my tokens?
questions.answer: Yes, tokens can be traded on our secondary market or held for long-term growth.

stillHaveQuestions.title: Still have questions?
stillHaveQuestions.description: Our support team is here to help with any inquiries

items.a: No. Real estate investing involves risk and returns are not guaranteed.
Create an account, explore opportunities, and review the details before investing.
Depending on the product, ownership may be recorded through platform records and/or blockchain proofs.
Liquidity depends on each opportunity’s terms and any available secondary options.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully before using Estathub.

veryImportant.title: Very Important
veryImportant.description: Please read these terms carefully. By using the Estathub platform, you agree to comply with these terms and conditions. If you do not agree to these terms, please stop using the platform immediately.

acceptanceOfTerms.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
acceptanceOfTerms.content1: By accessing or using the Estathub platform ("Platform"), you agree to comply with these terms and conditions ("Terms") and our privacy policy. If you do not agree to these terms, you must stop using the platform immediately.
acceptanceOfTerms.content2: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. You will be notified of any changes through the platform or via your registered email. Continued use of the platform after any modifications constitutes acceptance of the modified terms.

eligibilityAcceptance.title: 2. Eligibility and Acceptance
eligibilityAcceptance.description: To register and use the platform, you must:
requirements: Have legal capacity to enter into contracts in Saudi Arabia
Provide accurate and truthful information during registration
Commit to updating your personal information when it changes
Have a valid Saudi bank account
eligibilityAcceptance.note: We reserve the right to refuse or cancel accounts of any user who does not comply with these requirements.

riskAcknowledgment.title: Risk Acknowledgment:
risks: Real estate investment involves financial risks, including potential loss of capital
Investment values can increase or decrease based on market conditions
Past returns do not guarantee future results
Liquidity in real estate investments is limited compared to other assets

investorResponsibilities.title: Investor Responsibilities:
investorResponsibilities.description: By using the platform, you commit to the following:
responsibilities: Conduct personal research and analysis before investing
Full understanding of risks associated with each investment
Invest amounts you can afford to lose
Consult with a certified financial advisor when needed

userObligations.title: 4. User Obligations
userObligations.content1: By using the platform, you commit to the following:
obligations: Provide accurate and truthful information at all times
Maintain confidentiality of your account credentials
Not use the platform for illegal or fraudulent purposes
Respect intellectual property rights of the platform and other users
Not interfere with platform operation or cause technical damage

feesCosts.title: 5. Fees and Costs
feesCosts.description: The platform applies the following fee structure:
feeStructure: Investment fees: No fees on initial investment
Performance fees: 2% on realized profits only
Withdrawal fees: No fees on standard withdrawals
Additional fees: May apply to special services upon user request
feesCosts.note: All fees are clearly disclosed before completing any transaction. We reserve the right to modify the fee structure with 30 days prior notice.

serviceTermination.title: 6. Service Termination
serviceTermination.description: You can terminate your use of the platform at any time by closing your account. We reserve the right to:
rights: Suspend or close your account for violating these terms
Terminate service for security or regulatory reasons
Restrict access to your account without prior notice in emergency situations
serviceTermination.note: Upon account closure, active investments will be processed according to the terms applicable at the time of investment.

contactInformation.title: 7. Contact Information
contactInformation.description: For any inquiries about these terms, please contact us:

privacyCommitment.title: Our Privacy Commitment
privacyCommitment.description: At Estathub, we are committed to protecting your privacy and the security of your personal data. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information in accordance with personal data protection regulations in Saudi Arabia.

personalData.title: Personal Data:

howWeUseData.title: 2. How We Use Your Data

purposes: Providing real estate investment services and managing your account
Improving service quality and user experience
Communicating with you about your transactions and investments
Providing technical support and customer service
Protecting platform security and preventing fraud
Compliance with applicable laws and regulations

dataProtection.description: We take comprehensive security measures to protect your data:

dataProtection.note: Note: We never sell your data to third parties, and we only share it with your consent or as legally required.

rights.title: Right to Object:

Analytical cookies: to understand how the site is used
Functional cookies: to remember your preferences
